title: Withdraw unaccepted retrieval activation and correct invalid evaluation evidence
invalidated_prior_claims: The prior 8/8 acceptance is invalid. 210 template-derived fixtures were embedded, while 9790 distractors used random unit vectors. No prior-runtime baseline, source-family holdout split or independent adjudication was established.
Repeated queries reused LocalEmbeddingEngine._query_cache. Prior p95 did not include fresh embedding plus authorized owner hydration; cold start was measured after all quality queries.
Qdrant used dense-only search, without required sparse/native-RRF comparison. Total operational cost, image/dependency latest-compatible selection and model cohort numbers were not substantiated.
The postgres role used in the actual local database is both superuser and BYPASSRLS. RLS support was incorrectly presented as enforced isolation.
Product request bodies supplied authorization. Candidate memory projection invented tenant/workspace/scope defaults, and owner hydration omitted version/ACL/expiry checks.
Index tombstone exceptions were suppressed before advancing the checkpoint. Full restart/rebuild recovery, privacy and scope/count/citation nonleakage were not proved.
Negative semantic matching was evaluator-only; its per-record cosine scan did not migrate the production consumer.
scoped_changes: Restore product Search main/gateway/index pipeline, Dockerfile and requirements to current-dev sole runtime; preserve additive tenant/as-of checks.
Restore Memory main and negative_memory to current-dev owner retrieval/writeback and deterministic matching.
Remove Search service activation from isolated comparison Compose. No existing container or hosted environment was changed.
Replace misleading evaluator with fail-closed admission report and explicitly unaccepted bounded read-only local diagnostics; exit 2 for unresolved acceptance.
Invalidate selected-backend contract and unsubstantiated model comparison numbers. Preserve disconnected prototypes for correction, not production adoption.
Add activation and admission tests that reject implicit DSN activation and legacy success reports.
